The '''Ragnook system''' was located in the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Ragnook Mountains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] as well as the beverage known as [[Ragnook Spring Water]], which was served in the [[Jaded Jawa]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on that world.<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ragnook [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-14.<ref name="TEA" />
